name: FC Porto vs Sporting CP
description: FC Porto host Sporting CP at the Estádio do Dragão on Sunday 29 November at 20:30. Tickets via Gomry (resale).
longDescription:
FC Porto play Sporting CP at home at the Estádio do Dragão on Sunday 29 November at 20:30. Kickoff times can still be moved by the league, so check before you go.

The stadium has its own metro stop, Estádio do Dragão (lines A, B, E and F).

Tickets are sold through Gomry, a resale platform.
descriptionPt: O FC Porto recebe o Sporting CP no Estádio do Dragão, domingo, 29 de novembro, às 20:30. Bilhetes via Gomry (revenda).
